title: PR paths-ignore lists must mirror the web JS exclusions for TypeScript SDK paths
answers: Why does a TypeScript SDK-only PR start MLflow tests, tracing and R CI?
Why do changes to only libs/typescript or copilot workflow files trigger unrelated CI jobs?
How do I stop Copilot workflow-only PRs from running build-wheel, master or examples?
Which pull_request paths-ignore entries must I add when a new sub-project's CI should be skipped?
body:
Symptom: A PR that only changes the TypeScript SDK (libs/typescript) or only Copilot workflow files (.github/workflows/copilot-*.yml) starts unrelated CI jobs such as MLflow tests, cross-version tests, tracing, examples, fs2db, build-wheel and R, which wastes CI time.
Root cause: The pull_request `paths-ignore` lists in .github/workflows/master.yml, tracing.yml, examples.yml, cross-version-tests.yml, fs2db.yml, build-wheel.yml and r.yml only excluded the web JS paths (mlflow/server/js/**, .github/workflows/js.yml), not libs/typescript/** or .github/workflows/typescript.yml. The copilot-*.yml pattern was likewise absent from these lists.
Fix pattern: Add `libs/typescript/**` and `.github/workflows/typescript.yml` directly after the `.github/workflows/js.yml` entry in every PR-triggered paths-ignore list. Add `.github/workflows/copilot-*.yml` directly before `.github/workflows/docs.yml` in the eight lists (build-wheel, cross-version-tests, examples, fs2db, master, r, tracing, typescript), keeping existing ignore rules intact.
Constraints: Only the pull_request paths-ignore lists change; push, schedule and workflow_dispatch triggers stay as they were. Mixed TypeScript and Python PRs still run these workflows, because paths-ignore only skips a run when every changed file matches. The TypeScript SDK workflow and the always-on lint workflows keep running for TypeScript changes.
Applies: pull_request path filters in MLflow GitHub Actions workflows when a sub-project's CI or Copilot workflow-only changes should be skipped. Does not apply to push or scheduled triggers.
